items.text: Chéng sits on a mat, tending to his sword. The blade catches the light as it turns, casting a few bright reflections into Doctor Xiù's wine bowl.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: *sigh* Always wound so tight. The real showdown is tomorrow, so why not relax a little? There'll be no coming back from this one.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I clean my weapon every night and reflect on the day's deeds. One must restrain oneself and submit to proper conduct.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Of course. Forget I said anything.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It is precisely because I'm dueling you that I must prepare all the more.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Do you truly need the money so dearly? Is that why you're so set on defeating me?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It's not about the money. Fulfilling this task will give me a chance at a constable's posting.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Ah. So you need credentials, then.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The circumstances of my birth limit my avenues into court.
Doctor Xiù takes another sip of her wine.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: The court again! Why does everyone have such great desires to hold office?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Your father said the same thing once. He told me I was not to come looking for him again, saying, "You and I are no longer the same. I am an official now. I have a life in Zhu County."

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I said to him, "People must eat, must they not? Floods have brought ruin to the fields, and children are starving." But did he listen?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I didn't ask much of him. Just to leave a door open for us, and we'd make it worth his while—

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I know the story.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: "Case Record: Chéng Dàoguān, garrison officer of Zhu County, on account of personal ties, led bandits into the city and permitted the plundering of the county granaries; further charges include accepting bribes. All statements are entered on record."

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: After the bandits entered the city, they not only looted the granaries but also vandalized and ransacked nearby homes, drawing the people into their violence. That night, 24 people were killed or injured.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: "In the evening, Commander Chéng instructed us to change shifts early. We were unaware of any looting. I swear that this given statement is true."

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: When the bandits ransacked the surrounding areas, there were no officers nearby to hear the people's cries for help.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Am I wrong?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: They weren't always bandits. They were once refugees, those who had lost their land and couldn't get enough to eat.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What difference does that make?!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Talking on this further is pointless.
Chéng sheaths his blade and steps out of the clinic before Doctor Xiù can reply.
The night grows hazy, draping a faint veil over the trees in the forest.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What was I expecting?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Some hidden, nonexistent truth?
Chéng leaves the dirt road and turns into the forest. Along the path's edge, the darkening grass and shrubs bow away to either side.
Layer by layer, the dense, overlapping branches part as he moves deeper into the forest's embrace.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: There was no hidden truth, no injustice, just a transaction, one that may even have helped the refugees.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But your duty was to protect the people of Zhu County. How could you sacrifice their lives?!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You should have thought about your actions, stopped to think what could have—
He stops in his tracks.
It's a clearing in the forest, a tiger crouching at its center.
Enormous and beautiful, the tiger bears a silent blue flame upon its brow, its fur shimmering like moonlit silk.
Chéng recognizes a familiar wound on its forehead.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: That's the same tiger that attacked me a few days ago! But I saw it fall from the cliff with my own eyes.
The tiger pays no attention to him. Instead, it stretches its neck, lets out a deep, resounding call, and springs forward to the north.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: That's the direction of the clinic!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hold there!
Chéng Héguāng clenches his fists, sending dozens of blades after the tiger.
They converge on it in an instant, only to ricochet outward, bursting apart like fireworks.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What on ...?!
He tries once more, but the blades are again knocked away. It seems the tiger's fur is tougher than any steel.
It isn't long before the tiger arrives at the clinic, Chéng in close pursuit. He can only watch as it brings down the south wall with a single strike.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Doctor Xiù, watch out!
The tiger lifts its front paws high, then freezes.
Hair-thin silver threads lace around it, binding it like a fly in a web.
Inside the half-collapsed house, Doctor Xiù grips her bone shuttle, placing herself in front of the collapsed hunter clinging to a small wooden container.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What are you doing here?!

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: I-I came to deliver this chicken soup. We cooked a big pot of it at home earlier tonight!

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: This wasn't me! I didn't lead the tiger here! I had thought it dead already!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Chéng Héguāng! Get him out of here! This beast is too strong!
Her words and body shake with the effort of holding the tiger in place.
Chéng leaps in behind her and swiftly lifts the hunter to his feet.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Get up! Run!

items.speaker: Tiger
items.text: Graaargh!
The tiger tenses, and a second later, the silver threads snap.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: AAAHHH!
Amid a burst of dust and debris, Chéng grabs the hunter and rolls aside.
When the dust clears, the clinic lies in ruins, and Doctor Xiù is nowhere to be seen. The tiger stalks toward Chéng, a severed right arm clenched in its jaws.

items.speaker: Tiger
items.text: *roar*
Chéng catches a glimpse of Doctor Xiù's bone shuttle glinting between the tiger's fangs before it disappears down its throat.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Get out of here! Now! Go back and find the village headman!

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: What about you?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I will deal with it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But first, I must get in closer. Much closer.
The hunter flees at full speed as the tiger lunges toward Chéng.
He slips past the tiger's attack, leaps upward, and strikes down from above.
Golden sparks scatter as white fur and cold steel collide. The strike has forced open a hairline cut in the tiger's hardened hide, but the blade is now lodged in it.
Chéng grips the blade's hilt, closes his eyes, and draws in a deep breath.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Sense the flow of Qi. Find the shuttle in the tiger's stomach. I can do this.
It takes a moment, but soon enough, he begins to feel the flow of Qi in the tiger's body.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Through the muscles, I can feel it, the shuttle's unmistakable Qi.
The innards of this arcane creature have churned and tangled its Qi into a chaotic mass, one that Chéng fears he lacks the ability to unravel.
As he probes further, the Qi grows cold and dense, as if it were closing in around him.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It's cold, like winter.
You fool of a boy! You are not to use your arcane skill again, do you hear me? Are you trying to get us all killed?
It's best you don't come to training tomorrow.
You're not selling the house anymore? Oh, I see. My condolences.
He's really dead?
An accident. Who'd have thought a military officer would be so fragile!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No! No, no, no!
Snow drifts down onto the narrow courtyard. In Huanzhou, it seems the snow never truly ends.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: How can I find what he wants? Where do I even begin? I've already searched every corner of the courtyard.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Mmm. But returning empty-handed would mean admitting defeat to Father, and I refuse to do that again.
The stubborn child turns his gaze toward the open gate and beyond.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: They told me never to go out there. That once I step through that gate, I'll never be able to come home again.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But I have to. I have to go through it. Maybe what he wants is on the road, and if I can find a way out, then I can find a way back in.
He steels himself and takes a tentative step outside.

items.speaker: Father
items.text:
Héguāng, trust your sense of Qi. 
It will show you more than your eyes alone.
A slight tremor ripples beneath the snow.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I found it! I found it!
Qi closes around the shape of something solid, and Chéng's eyes snap open.
The shuttle hardens in an instant, as though already clenched in his hand.
He recalls what he learned as a child, hunting alongside the sons of wealthy families.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Ahead of the stomach.
A piercing scream bursts forth from the tiger's throat as its struggles grow frantic.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Angle inward above the foreleg, beneath the ribs. And ...

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Your heart is right here!

items.speaker: Tiger
items.text: *roar*
Chéng can no longer hold on as the tiger's death throes turn wild.
The tiger gives one last painful roar and thrashes across the ground before stillness takes it.
The now-metallic shuttle bursts through the tiger's chest and rolls to a stop beside Chéng.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Nicely done. *gasp*
Doctor Xiù staggers up to him, laboring to guide her silver thread to stitch the gushing wound on her right arm.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Are you able to stand?
Chéng forces a faint smile and sucks in a sharp breath of cold air.
Some time later, torchlight begins to flicker along the forest's edge. The village guards have finally arrived, fully armed and ready.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: I've brought help!

items.speaker: Headman
items.text: I thought you said there was a tiger? Where, huh? It's dead?
Fine snow drifts down like fuzzy willow catkins.
Winter is drawing to a close.
